exposure: Women with at least one statistically significant MRI sign of MAP
Presence or absence of specific MRI signs for MAP
MRI signs of morbidly adherent placenta (MAP)
Women with at least two statistically significant MRI signs of MAP
Women with at least one MRI sign of MAP
outcome: Accuracy of MRI in diagnosing morbidly adherent placenta (MAP)
cohort: The study included 27 women who underwent MRI for suspected MAP.
finding: The presence of at least two specific MRI signs together was able to correctly predict MAP at histopathology with 100% accuracy.
